location.name: m_seed4

location.name: j_dendrite_beta

location.note: dendrite Julia at its beta point (the end of the 0 ray), eight turns: one arm per turn, wide sweeping cells

bronze_packing.name: bronze_packing
bronze_packing.source: bronze_packing, authored as 10 control points (brown-black through copper, bronze and gold to a warm cream) as the albedo of the bronze_packing style, its hues read off the reference by lightness twentile and its top half pushed warmer and more saturated than the reference's mean, since the style's lights supply the near-whites and its tone pass sets the frame's key.

floating_on_dreams.name: floating_on_dreams
floating_on_dreams.source: floating_on_dreams, authored as 12 OKLCH control points (pale aqua-white through teal and sea green to lime, the greens warmed towards lime) as the albedo of the floating_on_dreams style, measured off its reference image and fitted under the style's lighting.

gilded_orbs.name: gilded_orbs
gilded_orbs.source: gilded_orbs, authored as 10 control points (near-black umber through bronze and old gold to a warm pale gold) as the albedo of the gilded_orbs style: the reference's warm pixels read by lightness decile, each pushed more saturated and the top end held below white, since the style's lights and glows supply the near-whites. The orbs' blue is the style's own paint, not the map's.

glossy_lobes.name: glossy_lobes
glossy_lobes.source: glossy_lobes, authored as 11 control points as the albedo of the glossy_lobes style: deep navy through slate blue (the reference's cool pixels by lightness decile) crossing a dark olive into old gold (its warm pixels), ending in a warm orange for the star cores, each stop a little more saturated than the reference's means; the gold stops sit near the reference's top warm deciles rather than below them, since the tone pass pins the median and a frame with navy gaps otherwise reads p90 low.

lit_petals.name: lit_petals
lit_petals.source: lit_petals, authored as 12 control points as the albedo of the lit_petals style, in the order the reference's rosette runs from its ground inwards: a deep saturated teal ground through sea-green into the cream and gold outer petals, then orange, maroon and plum inner petals and a teal heart that returns to the ground, so the map is cyclic and a jewel layer cycling it fast never meets a seam; the teal and cream stops are more saturated than the reference's pixels, since the petals' light and the tone pass both pull towards grey.

ribbon_packing.name: ribbon_packing
ribbon_packing.source: ribbon_packing, authored as 10 control points (deep violet-navy through plum and mauve to copper, orange-gold and a warm cream) as the albedo of the ribbon_packing style: the discs' plum and mauve read off the reference's warm pixels by lightness decile, the field's orange pushed warmer and more saturated than its mean (which the mauve discs grey), since the style's lights supply the near-whites. The ribbons' blue is the style's own paint, not the map's.

shaded_blades.name: shaded_blades
shaded_blades.source: shaded_blades, authored as 11 control points as the albedo of the shaded_blades style: the reference's blades by lightness decile, warm and cool interleaved so a few cycles over the trap's entry step give neighbouring blades different hues (near-black, maroon, slate, copper, blue-grey, cream), each more saturated than the reference's means, since the light's sheen and the tone pass grey them, and its top end (cream and pale silver) held a step darker than the reference's, since the style's light supplies the sheen and a frame filled by one cream blade otherwise reads p90 high.

teal_tunnel.name: teal_tunnel
teal_tunnel.source: teal_tunnel, authored as 10 control points (near-black navy through deep teal to bright cyan) as the albedo of the teal_tunnel style, read off its reference by lightness twentile and pulled darker at the low end, since the style's lights supply the band sheen and its tone pass sets the frame's key.

yas.name: yas
yas.source: yas, authored as 10 control points (deep blue through blue-teal, teal and olive to gold and cream) as the albedo of the yas style, measured ring by ring off its reference image by distance from the core, from the brightest strands of each ring rather than its mean, since the style's tone pass sets the frame's lightness and the sheets carry the contrast.
